panels.description:
MRs created in the period split into Merged, Open, Closed and Draft. Drafts are open MRs whose title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP]. MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created in the range split into Merged, Open, Closed and Draft.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant).
-- GitLab's is_draft is always 0, so an open MR is a Draft when its title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP].
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pr.status = 'MERGED'), 0)                        AS Merged,
       COALESCE(SUM(pr.status = 'OPEN' AND NOT (LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])')), 0)           AS Open,
       COALESCE(SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED'), 0)                        AS Closed,
       COALESCE(SUM(pr.status = 'OPEN' AND (LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])')), 0)               AS Draft
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_')
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.description:
Merged MRs with no approval from someone other than the author still standing at merge time. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out; approvals by bots don't count.
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Merged MRs with no approval from anyone other than the author still standing at merge time.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant).
-- An approval is a GitLab approval or a "**Review:** Approved" note, and a revoke is an unapproval or a "**Review:**
-- Changes requested" note, as on dashboard C's panels 9 and 10. Approvals by bots don't count.
-- Bot-authored MRs are left out (C's developer list already leaves bots out).
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM pull_request_comments c
         WHERE c.pull_request_id = pr.id
           AND c.created_date <= pr.merged_date
           AND ((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ra WHERE ra.id = c.account_id AND ra.user_name REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_')
           AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
           -- still standing at merge time: the approver did not unapprove afterwards
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments u
                            WHERE u.pull_request_id = pr.id
                              AND u.account_id = c.account_id
                              AND (u.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR u.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%')
                              AND u.created_date > c.created_date
                              AND u.created_date <= pr.merged_date)
       )), 0) AS `Unapproved MRs`
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED'
  AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_')
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.description:
Average lines changed per MR, merge commits excluded. MRs whose commits were not collected, MRs imported from GitHub and environment promotion MRs (e.g. dev -> stage) are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_commits, commits, commit_parents, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average lines changed per MR across its commits, merge commits excluded, as on dashboard C's MR Size panel.
-- MRs whose commits were not collected and environment promotion MRs (from a branch that at least 20 MRs target)
-- are left out.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant).
WITH long_lived_branches AS (
  SELECT lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  FROM pull_requests lb
  WHERE lb.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
mr_size AS (
  SELECT pr.id,
         SUM(c.additions + c.deletions) AS lines_changed
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  JOIN commits c                ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_')
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_lived_branches llb WHERE llb.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND llb.base_ref = pr.head_ref)
  GROUP BY pr.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(lines_changed)) AS `Average MR Size`
FROM mr_size;

panels.description:
Average days from MR creation to merge, for MRs merged in the period. MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average days from MR creation to merge, for MRs merged in the range.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant).
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date)) / 1440, 1) AS `Average Merge Days`
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.status      = 'MERGED'
  AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND pr.merged_date > pr.created_date
  AND pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_')
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: Average MR Merge Time (Days)

panels.description:
MR commits authored in the period, merge commits excluded. Commit authors are matched to GitLab accounts by the part of the email before the @ (against the username), then by name; unmatched authors count under Unassigned. All counts every author, bots included. Commits of MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_request_commits, pull_requests, commit_parents, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MR commits authored in the range, each counted once, merge commits excluded where parent data was collected.
-- Commit authors are matched to GitLab accounts as on dashboard B; unmatched authors count under Unassigned.
-- All counts every author, whether or not they are in the developer list. Bot accounts count like any other author: under
-- All, and under the bot when issues are assigned to it (so it is in the list), the same as in the CI/CD panels.
-- Commits of MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant).
WITH mr_commits AS (
  SELECT prc.commit_sha,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_email)  AS author_email,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_name)   AS author_name
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(prc.commit_authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha) < 2
  GROUP BY prc.commit_sha
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM mr_commits) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Commits
FROM mr_commits mc
JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> mc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> mc.author_name
WHERE ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR ca.account_id IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR (ca.account_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} )));

panels.title: Commits Raised

panels.description:
Issues created in the period split into Bugs and Tasks (every other type). The type comes from issue labels. The developer filter matches any of an issue's assignees.
datasource: issues, issue_labels, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Issue stats per type (Bugs, Tasks), the only issue query on this dashboard: the status pies and every issue stat
-- read their numbers from this panel's result. The developer filter matches any of the issue's assignees (issue_owners,
-- as on dashboards E and H); an issue counts once. Unassigned ignores the developer filter, as on GitHub A: it counts
-- every unassigned issue created in the range.
-- An issue is a Bug when it has a bug label or original_type INCIDENT (the bug_issue constant); every other issue is a Task.
-- Counts cover issues created in the range. GitLab issues are only open or closed, so an open issue is In Progress when it has
-- an in-progress label (the in_progress_issue constant), as on dashboard E. Average Days is the lead time of issues closed
-- in the range.
WITH issue_owners AS (
  -- an issue's assignees from issue_assignees, or its issues.assignee_id when it has none (NULL when unassigned);
  -- the :0 placeholder account means unassigned
  SELECT ia.issue_id, ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  WHERE ia.issue_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ia.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END, NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), '')
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_assignees ia WHERE ia.issue_id = i.id AND ia.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0')
),
owner_flags AS (
  -- per issue: whether it has an assignee, and whether one of its assignees (or Unassigned) is selected
  SELECT io.issue_id,
         MAX(io.assignee_id IS NOT NULL)                                                                       AS assigned,
         COALESCE(MAX(io.assignee_id IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR (io.assignee_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} ))), 0) AS selected
  FROM issue_owners io
  GROUP BY io.issue_id
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN ${bug_issue:raw} THEN 'Bugs' ELSE 'Tasks' END    AS category,
         $__timeFilter(i.created_date)                     AS created_in_range,
         i.status = 'DONE'                                 AS done,
         ${in_progress_issue:raw}                          AS progress_label,
         NOT o.assigned                                    AS unassigned,
         ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR o.selected)  AS selected,
         CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE' AND i.lead_time_minutes > 0 AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
              THEN i.lead_time_minutes / 1440 END           AS resolved_days
  FROM issues i
  JOIN owner_flags o ON o.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ($__timeFilter(i.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT category,
       SUM(selected AND created_in_range)                                   AS issues,
       SUM(selected AND created_in_range AND NOT done AND progress_label)   AS `In Progress`,
       SUM(selected AND created_in_range AND NOT done AND NOT progress_label) AS `To Do`,
       SUM(selected AND created_in_range AND done)                          AS Done,
       SUM(created_in_range AND unassigned)                                 AS Unassigned,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN selected THEN resolved_days END), 1)             AS `Average Days`
FROM scoped
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

panels.description:
Pipelines in the period by result, by finished date (created date while they have none). Unknown = no final result yet (manual, running, pending, skipped); Failure includes canceled pipelines. A pipeline belongs to its commit's author; unmatched authors count under Unassigned. All counts every pipeline, bots included. Child pipelines are left out.
datasource: cicd_pipelines, cicd_pipeline_commits, commits, pull_request_commits, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Pipelines in the range by result: by finished date, or by created date while they have none (a pipeline waiting on a
-- manual job, or still running). Unknown = no final result yet (manual, running, pending, skipped); FAILURE includes
-- canceled pipelines.
-- A pipeline belongs to the author of its commit, from commits or else the MR commit, matched to GitLab accounts as on
-- dashboard B; pipelines whose author is unknown or unmatched count under Unassigned.
-- All counts every author, whether or not they are in the developer list. Bot accounts count like any other author: under
-- All, and under the bot when issues are assigned to it (so it is in the list), the same as in Commits Raised.
-- Child pipelines (is_child) are left out: they run as part of their parent pipeline.
WITH mr_commit_authors AS (
  -- MR commit authors grouped once per commit: pull_request_commits has no index on commit_sha
  SELECT prc.commit_sha,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_email)  AS author_email,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_name)   AS author_name
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY prc.commit_sha
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT cp.id,
         cp.result,
         MAX(COALESCE(c.author_email, mca.author_email)) AS author_email,
         MAX(COALESCE(c.author_name,  mca.author_name))  AS author_name
  FROM cicd_pipelines cp
  LEFT JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits cpc ON cpc.pipeline_id = cp.id
  LEFT JOIN commits c                 ON c.sha = cpc.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN mr_commit_authors mca     ON mca.commit_sha = cpc.commit_sha
  WHERE cp.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND COALESCE(cp.is_child, 0) = 0
    AND COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND cp.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = cp.cicd_scope_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY cp.id, cp.result
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM pipelines) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT IF(p.result = '', 'Unknown', p.result) AS result,
       COUNT(*)                               AS build_count
FROM pipelines p
LEFT JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> p.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> p.author_name
WHERE ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR ca.account_id IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR (ca.account_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} )))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.description:
MRs whose commits had a pipeline fail or get canceled in the period, latest failure first (100 most recent). MRs imported from GitHub, bot-authored MRs and environment promotion MRs (e.g. dev -> stage) are left out. Child pipelines are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_commits, cicd_pipeline_commits, cicd_pipelines, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs by the selected developers with a commit whose pipeline failed (or was canceled) in the range, latest failure first.
-- Bot-authored MRs are left out. GitLab leaves merged_by_id empty, so there is no Merged By column.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant).
-- Environment promotion MRs (from a branch that at least 20 MRs target, e.g. dev -> stage) are left out, as in Average
-- MR Size: they carry every commit of the source branch, so they collect every failure on it.
-- The selected MRs come first and reach their commits through pull_request_commits' primary key; that table has no index
-- on commit_sha, so starting from the failed pipelines scans all of it.
-- Child pipelines (is_child) are left out: they run as part of their parent pipeline.
WITH long_lived_branches AS (
  SELECT lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  FROM pull_requests lb
  WHERE lb.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
selected_mrs AS (
  SELECT pr.id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR pr.author_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_')
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_lived_branches llb WHERE llb.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND llb.base_ref = pr.head_ref)
),
failed_commits AS (
  -- commits of the pipelines that failed in the range; grouped, so MySQL materializes this small set once
  SELECT cpc.commit_sha,
         cp.id                  AS pipeline_id,
         MAX(cp.finished_date)  AS finished_date
  FROM cicd_pipelines cp
  JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits cpc ON cpc.pipeline_id = cp.id
  WHERE cp.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND COALESCE(cp.is_child, 0) = 0
    AND cp.result = 'FAILURE'
    AND $__timeFilter(cp.finished_date)
    AND cp.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = cp.cicd_scope_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY cpc.commit_sha, cp.id
),
mr_commits AS (
  -- the selected MRs' commits, through pull_request_commits' primary key; DISTINCT keeps this a separate step
  SELECT DISTINCT prc.pull_request_id, prc.commit_sha
  FROM selected_mrs sm
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = sm.id
),
mr_failures AS (
  SELECT mc.pull_request_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT fc.pipeline_id)  AS failed_pipelines,
         MAX(fc.finished_date)           AS last_failure
  FROM mr_commits mc
  JOIN failed_commits fc ON fc.commit_sha = mc.commit_sha
  GROUP BY mc.pull_request_id
)
SELECT pr.title                                 AS Title,
       pr.base_ref                              AS `Target Branch`,
       pr.head_ref                              AS `Source Branch`,
       COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)') AS Author,
       mf.failed_pipelines                      AS `Failed Pipelines`,
       mf.last_failure                          AS `Last Failure`,
       pr.url                                   AS URL
FROM mr_failures mf
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = mf.pull_request_id
LEFT JOIN accounts a  ON a.id = pr.author_id
ORDER BY `Last Failure` DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.description:
Top 10 assignees by issues created in the period (an issue with several assignees counts for each), their share of the team's issues, and how far they are from the fair share (Overloaded above 125%, Underloaded below 75%).
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues created in the range per assignee, top 10, against the team's fair share. An issue with several assignees counts
-- once for each, as on dashboards E and H; unassigned issues are left out. The fair share is
-- total issues divided by the number of assignees. Over 125% of the fair share is Overloaded, under 75% Underloaded.
-- Team Workload Overview reads this panel's result.
WITH issue_owners AS (
  -- an issue's assignees from issue_assignees, or its issues.assignee_id when it has none (NULL when unassigned);
  -- the :0 placeholder account means unassigned
  SELECT ia.issue_id, ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  WHERE ia.issue_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ia.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END, NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), '')
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_assignees ia WHERE ia.issue_id = i.id AND ia.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0')
),
per_member AS (
  SELECT io.assignee_id          AS member_id,
         MAX(io.assignee_name)   AS assignee_name,
         COUNT(*)                AS tasks
  FROM issues i
  JOIN issue_owners io ON io.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND io.assignee_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all__' IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR io.assignee_id IN ( ${developer_id} ))
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY io.assignee_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(tasks) AS total_tasks, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM per_member
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(p.assignee_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), p.member_id)                                                 AS Developer,
       p.tasks                                                   AS `Issues Assigned`,
       ROUND(100.0 * p.tasks / t.total_tasks, 1)                 AS `Workload Percentage`,
       ROUND(t.total_tasks / t.headcount, 1)                     AS `Fair Share`,
       ROUND(p.tasks - t.total_tasks / t.headcount, 1)           AS Deviation,
       CASE
         WHEN p.tasks > (t.total_tasks / t.headcount) * 1.25 THEN 'Overloaded'
         WHEN p.tasks < (t.total_tasks / t.headcount) * 0.75 THEN 'Underloaded'
         ELSE 'Balanced'
       END                                                       AS Status,
       t.total_tasks                                             AS `Total Team Work`
FROM per_member p
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.member_id
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY p.tasks DESC
LIMIT 10;

list.definition:
SELECT Name FROM (
  WITH scoped_repos AS (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM repos r
    WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
      AND r.deleted = 0
      AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                   WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                     AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                     AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  ),
  scoped_issues AS (
    -- gitlab board ids match repo ids
    SELECT bi.issue_id
    FROM board_issues bi
    WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                   WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                     AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                     AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  ),
  scoped_accounts AS (
    -- MR authors
    SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id, NULL AS fallback_name, 0 AS assignee
    FROM pull_requests pr
    JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
    WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    -- MR reviewers and commenters
    SELECT cmt.account_id, NULL, 0
    FROM pull_request_comments cmt
    JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
    JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
    WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    -- issue assignees, from issue_assignees and issues.assignee_id (the :0 placeholder means unassigned)
    SELECT ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name, 1
    FROM issue_assignees ia
    JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
    WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    SELECT i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, 1
    FROM issues i
    JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
    WHERE i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
      AND i.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
  )
  -- assignees with no account row keep their GitLab username; bots are left out, unless issues are assigned to them
  SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(sa.fallback_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), sa.account_id), '--', sa.account_id) AS Name
  FROM scoped_accounts sa
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = sa.account_id
  GROUP BY sa.account_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
  HAVING MAX(sa.assignee) = 1 OR NOT COALESCE(a.user_name, '') REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Unassigned--unassigned'
) all_developers
ORDER BY Name
